name: Dottore And The Spy - EASTER Special
source:
Happy Easter, happy time at the castle with the Segments and Pantalone? Well, this is what was planned, but it seems like every Segment has a different understanding of the meaning "happy time"...

Enjoy this short special, spend time with everyone AGAIN and you also get to be a little more sarcasting and mean hehehe.

[from [url=https://byaku-to-kuro.itch.io/dottore-and-the-spy-easter-special]itch.io[/url]]
